title: The Cavern of Fear
author: Example Adventure
description: You are a brave adventurer who has discovered the entrance to a mysterious cavern. Legends speak of a powerful artifact hidden within, but many dangers await. Can you survive and claim the treasure?

sections.title: The Entrance
sections.text: You stand before a dark cavern entrance. The air is cold and damp, and you can hear strange echoes from within. A wooden sign near the entrance reads: 'Abandon hope, all ye who enter here.' Two paths lead into the darkness - one to the left appears well-worn, while the right path is covered in cobwebs.

choices.text: Take the left path (the well-worn route)
Take the right path (through the cobwebs)
Search around the entrance before proceeding

sections.title: The Well-Worn Path
sections.text: You follow the left path deeper into the cavern. The walls are smooth and the floor is packed dirt - clearly many others have passed this way. After a few minutes, you hear growling ahead. A CAVE TROLL emerges from the shadows, blocking your path!

sections.title: The Cobweb Path
sections.text: You push through the thick cobwebs, brushing them from your face. The path is narrow and rarely traveled. As you proceed, you notice something glinting in a corner - a small wooden chest! Do you investigate or continue forward?

sections.title: The Search
sections.text: You carefully search around the entrance. Behind a large rock, you discover a dusty old backpack! Inside you find a healing potion and a strange amulet with mystical symbols.

sections.title: Victory Over the Troll
sections.text: The troll falls with a mighty crash! As you catch your breath, you notice it was guarding a small pouch. Inside you find 10 gold pieces and a rusty key. The path continues deeper into the cavern, and you can see flickering light ahead.

addItems.name: Rusty Key
addItems.description: An old key - what does it unlock?

sections.title: The Trapped Chest
sections.text: As you open the chest, you hear a CLICK! A poison dart shoots out, grazing your arm. You lose 2 STAMINA points. Inside the chest, you find a silver dagger and a map of the cavern.

addItems.name: Silver Dagger
addItems.description: A fine blade, especially effective against dark creatures

addItems.name: Cavern Map
addItems.description: Shows the layout of the cave system

sections.title: The Underground River
sections.text: The path opens into a large chamber with an underground river flowing through it. A narrow stone bridge crosses the water. On the far side, you can see a doorway carved into the rock. The bridge looks old and unstable.

choices.text: Try to swim across the river

sections.title: The Treasure Chamber
sections.text: You emerge into a vast chamber lit by torches. In the center stands a pedestal with a locked chest upon it. The chest glows with an otherworldly light - this must be the legendary artifact! But as you approach, you hear a voice: 'None shall claim the treasure of Zargon!'

sections.title: A Brief Rest
sections.text: You take a moment to rest and tend your wounds. You recover 2 STAMINA points. Feeling refreshed, you continue toward the flickering light.

sections.title: The Bridge Crossing
sections.text: You carefully make your way across the bridge. The stones creak and shift beneath your feet, but you manage to reach the other side safely. Through the doorway, you see another chamber ahead.

sections.title: Swimming the River
sections.text: You dive into the cold water and begin swimming. The current is stronger than you expected! You must test your luck to see if you make it across safely.

testLuck.successText: You fight against the current and make it to the other side, exhausted but alive.
testLuck.failureText: The current sweeps you downstream! You struggle to reach the shore.

sections.title: The Side Passage
sections.text: You search along the cavern wall and find a narrow side passage. It's dark and tight, but it seems to lead in the right direction. As you squeeze through, you accidentally disturb a nest of GIANT BATS!

sections.title: The Locked Chest
sections.text: You examine the chest closely. It has an intricate lock mechanism. If you have a rusty key, you might be able to open it. Do you have the key?

choices.text: Use the rusty key (requires rusty key)
Try to force the lock (Test your Luck)

sections.title: The Guardian Appears
sections.text: A spectral figure materializes before you - the GHOST OF ZARGON! 'Foolish mortal!' it booms. 'You dare disturb my rest? Prepare to join me in eternal torment!' You must fight!

sections.title: Retreat
sections.text: You decide discretion is the better part of valor and retreat from the chamber. As you make your way back through the cavern, you realize you've escaped with your life, but the treasure remains unclaimed. Perhaps another adventurer will succeed where you did not.

sections.title: Swept Downstream
sections.text: The current pulls you under! You lose 3 STAMINA as you're battered against rocks. Finally, you manage to crawl onto a small beach. You're bruised and exhausted, but alive. You find yourself in a different part of the cavern system.

sections.title: The Key Fits!
sections.text: The rusty key slides into the lock and turns with a satisfying CLICK! The chest opens to reveal the CROWN OF ETERNITY, a magnificent artifact radiating magical power! As you lift it, you feel strength flowing through you. You have succeeded in your quest!

sections.title: Forcing the Lock
sections.text: You attempt to force the lock open. Test your luck!

sections.title: The Ghost is Vanquished
sections.text: With a final blow, the ghost dissipates with an anguished wail! As it fades, the chest's lock clicks open on its own. Inside you find the CROWN OF ETERNITY! You have defeated the guardian and claimed the treasure. Victory is yours!

sections.title: The Hidden Grotto
sections.text: You find yourself in a beautiful underground grotto. Luminescent fungi light the chamber with an eerie glow. In the center is a small pool of crystal-clear water. As you approach, you see coins glinting at the bottom.

choices.text: Drink from the pool (might restore health)

sections.title: The Trap Springs!
sections.text: As you try to force the lock, a magical trap is triggered! Searing energy blasts you backward. You lose 4 STAMINA. The chest remains locked. Maybe there's another way...

choices.text: Try again with the key if you have it

sections.title: The Magical Pool
sections.text: You drink from the pool. The water tastes sweet and pure. Warmth spreads through your body - your wounds heal! You restore 6 STAMINA points and feel incredibly lucky! Add 1 to your LUCK.

choices.text: Search for a way back to the main chambers

sections.title: Quick Treasure
sections.text: You scoop up the coins - 5 gold pieces - and look for an exit. You find a passage that seems to lead upward and back toward the main cavern system.

sections.title: Your Adventure Ends
sections.text: You have fallen in battle. Your adventure ends here in the dark depths of the Cavern of Fear. Your bones will join countless others who sought the legendary treasure and failed. The cavern's secrets remain hidden, waiting for the next brave (or foolish) adventurer...
